change: Classify attachment writes from enabled depth testing/writes and stencil masks/operations, including clears and back-face fallback; zero-mask/all-KEEP stencil testing remains read-only.
Use independent depth/stencil layouts and attachment write access only when required. Include shader-read stage/access scope for a sampled depth/stencil target.
Use STORE_OP_NONE for read-only depth/stencil aspects. Preserve STORE for writable aspects, including clears; color store operations unchanged.
Add sparsely sampled depth-stencil-access diagnostics with masks/operations, clears, selected layout and writable aspects. No addresses, game or shader selectors.
semantics: Host Vulkan layout/access/store correction. Guest operations, write masks, shader code, clear requests, draw calls and geometry are not changed. No new guest-emulation semantics or game-specific workaround.

validation.scope: Host build without a Vulkan ICD or games; native GPU acceptance pending.
validation.probe_method: Extract exact production helpers and transition block; compare supported stencil operations against enumerated stored-value changes for all 256 old byte values. Cover front/back fallback, masks, invalid aspects, depth/stencil clears, mixed layouts, shader-read scope and store preservation. Three old-layout regressions reproduced. Genuine writes retain writable layouts/stores.
validation.sanitizer_limit: ASan and UBSan passed with assertions enabled. Leak detection disabled because LeakSanitizer is unsupported under this host ptrace environment; no leak-validation claim.
